messages:
sam: Heads-up: SpriteCloud asked for a marketplace launch kit: benchmark blog, 20-30m webinar, and a how-to listing guide. can we support a May window?

elaine: Yes. Product needs to confirm GA artifact but early sign-off likely. prefer a concise benchmark narrative.

viv: I can take the benchmark writeup. need perf numbers (p50/p95 + $/1k tokens) and a reproducibility note. aim for simple charts.

mike: Eng: will run 48h steady-state on 512-token median. ETA 3 business days for final numbers and CSV. will avoid real customer prompts, will use synthetic set.

tori: Webinar ops: partner prefers Tue mornings PT. recommend 30m slot: 12m prerecord demo + 12m live Q&A + 6m wrap. registration page live at least 7 days prior.

legal-bot: POA requested. do not share logs or PII. consent language approved on record: "I consent to be contacted by SpriteCloud and Redwood regarding this integration."

ops-bot: Reminder: webhook routes must validate consent flag and restrict exports unless consent=true. rotate webhook tokens every 30 days.

sam: Lead routing plan: marketplace -> partner CRM webhook (minimal fields), mirror lead to SFDC with fields: LastName, Company, Email, UTM, Consent__c, Campaign=SPRITE-MAY-3012. require consent before any marketing exports.

viv: Blog draft will include: TL;DR results, methodology, two charts (latency & cost), short how-to for listing, CTA to webinar and partner onboarding.

mike: dropping perf artifacts to s3://redwood-partners/sprite/bench/3012345678/ and will include a small methods.csv and tokenization notes.

tori: Promo checklist: blog + landing, webinar reg + 3-email cadence (7/2/1 day), socials (3 clips), sales 1-pager, UTM tracking.

sam: Action items:
- mike: perf run + CSV + method note (due in 3 business)
- viv: blog + landing draft (due in 5 business)
- elaine: confirm product GA artifacts + partner assets (due in 2 business)
- tori: webinar page + recording plan (due in 7 business)
- ops-bot: draft webhook spec + sample payload for partner (due in 2 business)

elaine: partner agreed to provide a 1-line quote and logo files by EOD tomorrow.

sam: final sync Thurs 9am PT to review assets and routing. drop any blockers here before EOD. :rocket:
